name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Between Kael and Wrenna, one goes with Gnome and the other with 36 gp.
The Dwarf's gold is exactly 15 gp more than Wrenna.
Fenwick goes with none of Halfling, 31 gp, or 51 gp.
Wrenna goes with exactly one of Elf, Gnome, or 31 gp.
Exactly one of these is true: Thorne goes with 51 gp; Wrenna goes with 36 gp; Half-Orc goes with 41 gp.
If Half-Orc goes with Fenwick, then 31 gp does not go with Gnome.
